question: Select the synonym of **Pinnacle**.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Peak)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Pinnacle"** refers to the highest point of achievement or success; it can also mean the topmost part of a structure or mountain. (शिखर)

 
 
• **Example: **Winning the Nobel Prize is considered the pinnacle of a scientist's career.
 
 
 
• **"Peak"** refers to the highest point, either literally (like a mountain peak) or metaphorically, signifying the zenith of a career, life, or achievement. (चोटी)
 
 
• **Example: **He reached the peak of his career when he became the CEO of the company.
 
 
 
• Hence, "Pinnacle" and "Peak" are synonyms as both signify the top or highest point.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (Peak)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Base** (आधार): The lowest part or foundation of something.

 
 
• **Example: **The base of the mountain was surrounded by dense forests.
 
 
 
• **Decline** (पतन): A gradual decrease or deterioration in quality, importance, or power.
 
 
• **Example: **The company's profits showed a sharp decline over the last quarter.
 
 
 
• **Bottom** (नीचे या तल): The lowest part or point of something.
 
 
• **Example: **He searched for his keys at the bottom of the drawer.
